description: Regenerate the active CPFS rule (FEATURE / TARGET FILES / DO NOT REPEAT / REAL TEST BEFORE PASS / NO FALSE COMPLETION / checksum) and write it to the connected AI client's auto-read rules file (e.g. .cursor/rules/cpfs-active.mdc in Cursor, CLAUDE.md+AGENTS.md in Claude, .windsurfrules in Windsurf). Only the current client's file(s) are written — set CPFS_CLIENTS env to override. Call this after starting a feature or ending an attempt so the AI sees fresh context on every turn.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

name: cpfs_refresh_ai_context
